action.description:
The action. One call is one action:
* `left_click`: click the left button at `coordinate`
* `right_click`: click the right button at `coordinate` (a context menu)
* `middle_click`: click the middle button at `coordinate`
* `double_click`: double-click at `coordinate`
* `triple_click`: triple-click at `coordinate` (selects a line or paragraph)
* `mouse_move`: move the pointer to `coordinate` without pressing (hover)
* `left_click_drag`: press the left button at `start_coordinate`, move to `coordinate` while holding it, release there: moves, resizes, selects a range, draws a shape or line
* `type`: type `text` into the focused field
* `key`: press `keys` together as one chord, for example ["ctrl", "s"]
* `scroll`: scroll at `coordinate` by `pixels` (positive is down)
* `wait`: wait `time` seconds for the screen to change
* `ask`: ask the person `question`, with `choices` when there are a few answers
* `terminate`: end the run with `status` and a `summary` of what was done

coordinate.description: [x, y] in the screenshot's coordinates: the point of a click, a move or a scroll, and the end of a drag.

start_coordinate.description: [x, y] where a `left_click_drag` presses the button; the drag ends at `coordinate`.

keys.description: The keys `key` presses together, modifiers first.

pixels.description: How far `scroll` scrolls; positive is down.

status.description: Whether the goal was reached, for `terminate`.

question.description: The question `ask` puts to the person.

choices.description: The answers `ask` offers, when there are a few.
